# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOLUME_CLIMATE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A midday lull in volume often precedes a reversal when volume spikes, as latent orders are absorbed and price snaps back. This captures the liquidity-driven mean reversion that occurs when institutional orders are worked off during quiet periods, creating imbalances that resolve with aggressive volume.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Restrict to time between 11:00‑13:00 EST. Compute 5‑bar average volume. When volume < 0.5 × average for two consecutive bars, then look for a volume spike > 2 × average on the next bar; enter long if the spike bar closes above its open and the prior 5‑bar close was lower, otherwise enter short on the inverse conditions. Exit shape: Stop at the swing point prior to the volume spike (e.g., recent low for long); target at 1.5× risk or trail using a 10‑bar highest/lowest close. Regime hint: Optimal when VIX is moderate (15‑25) and the session is not dominated by strong news; avoid during the first 30 minutes or last 30 minutes and when VIX >30 (volume spikes often signal continuation).
